title: CORE-6995 · Header top-bar BSQ + B-Corp logos not clickable + missing target=_blank
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-6995](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-6995/rf-shared-header-top-bar-bsq-b-corp-logos-not-clickable-links-covered) · state `In Progress` · priority P2

## Ticket (verbatim from Linear)

**Page:** `/` (homepage) — **shared header** top utility bar, so affects every page
**Component:** Header top-right cluster — "Part of **bsq group**" logo + **Certified B-Corp** badge
**Breakpoints:** Wide desktop (the cluster only renders at large widths — visible at 1800; hidden by 1440). Applies wherever it renders.

## Issue

Both logos are wrapped in anchors in the DOM, but on the clone **the links can't be clicked** — the `<header>` wrapper is painted over them, so a click at the centre of each logo lands on the header, not the link. On live the same click lands on the linked image and navigates. The clone also drops `target="_blank"` / `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, so even once clickable it would open in the same tab instead of a new one.

Rendered sizes match live (BSQ 110→112px, B-Corp 45×76→44×74px — sub-perceptible), so this is a **link / stacking** defect, not a size one.

## Expected (Live) vs Actual (Clone)

| Element | Expected (Live) | Actual (Clone) |
| -- | -- | -- |
| BSQ logo — top hit element | image inside its own `<a>` (clickable) | `<header>` intercepts (link unreachable) |
| B-Corp badge — top hit element | image inside its own `<a>` (clickable) | `<header>` intercepts (link unreachable) |
| BSQ link | `bsqgroup.co.uk` · `target="_blank"` · `rel="noopener noreferrer"` | `bsqgroup.co.uk` · **no target** · **no rel** |
| B-Corp link | `bcorporation.net/.../bsq-group/` · `target="_blank"` · `rel` | same href · **no target** · **no rel** |

*Diagnostic:* `document.elementFromPoint(centre of each logo)` *→ Live returns* `IMG` *(inside the anchor); Clone returns* `HEADER`*.*

## Steps to replicate

1. Open the clone homepage at a wide desktop width (≈1800px) so the top-right "Part of bsq group / Certified B" cluster shows.
2. Click the BSQ logo, then the B-Corp badge → nothing happens.
3. On live, the same clicks open [bsqgroup.co.uk](<http://bsqgroup.co.uk>) / the B-Corp profile **in a new tab**.

## Definition of Done

* Both top-bar logos are clickable — the anchor is the top hit-target (not the header), at all desktop widths where the cluster renders.
* BSQ logo → `https://www.bsqgroup.co.uk/`, B-Corp badge → `https://www.bcorporation.net/en-us/find-a-b-corp/company/bsq-group/`, both `target="_blank"` + `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, matching live.
* No regression to the RF header logo (already correct) or top-bar layout.

## Evidence

Cluster renders identically (size/position); the defect is that the clone's copies aren't clickable. Live vs Clone top bar @1800:

| Live (links work, new tab) | Clone (links covered by header) |
| -- | -- |
|  |  |

---
### Routing note (Planning)
`rapid-formations-clone` has **no clone engine** — no `walk-dom-cdp.ts` / `emit-block.ts` /
`verify-clone.ts`, and zero `*Clone` blocks. Every block here is hand-authored, so the
engine-first rule has nothing to diagnose into: this is a **direct fix in the block that
has the defect**. That is why the task is tagged `bug` — it is NOT a fidelity loophole.

**Ship path:** Mode X — `clone-pull-request-create` with per-breakpoint PROD-vs-clone
screenshot proof, land `awaiting-user`, **the USER merges the PR**. Never merge to main.
Live source of truth: `https://www.rapidformations.co.uk` · clone:
`https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app`. ⛔ HEADED browser only for any visual check.
acceptanceCriteria: Both top-bar logos are clickable — the anchor is the top hit-target, not the `<header>`, at all desktop widths where the cluster renders (visible at 1800, hidden by 1440). Verify with `document.elementFromPoint` at each logo centre: must return the `IMG`/anchor, not `HEADER`.

BSQ logo → `https://www.bsqgroup.co.uk/`, B-Corp badge → `https://www.bcorporation.net/en-us/find-a-b-corp/company/bsq-group/`, both with `target="_blank"` + `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, matching live.
No regression to the RF header logo (already correct) or to top-bar layout — rendered sizes stay as-is (BSQ ~112px, B-Corp ~44×74).
